Reentrancy in StableStaker.stake(address,uint256) (src/StableStaker.sol#289-307):
	External calls:
	- _settle(msg.sender,user,pool) (src/StableStaker.sol#297)
		- phUSD.mint(account,pending) (src/StableStaker.sol#733)
	- credited = _routeDeposit(token,received) (src/StableStaker.sol#300)
		- strategy.deposit(token,amount,address(this)) (src/StableStaker.sol#761)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- pool.totalStaked += credited (src/StableStaker.sol#303)
	StableStaker.poolInfo (src/StableStaker.sol#75) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- StableStaker._updatePool(address) (src/StableStaker.sol#705-726)
	- StableStaker.addToken(address) (src/StableStaker.sol#172-177)
	- StableStaker.finalizeAndReset(address) (src/StableStaker.sol#593-604)
	- StableStaker.pendingReward(address,address) (src/StableStaker.sol#644-654)
	- StableStaker.phUSDPerDay(address,uint256) (src/StableStaker.sol#184-189)
	- StableStaker.poolInfo (src/StableStaker.sol#75)
	- StableStaker.rescueERC20(address,address,uint256) (src/StableStaker.sol#807-814)
	- StableStaker.setYieldStrategy(address,IYieldStrategy) (src/StableStaker.sol#219-271)
	- user.amount += credited (src/StableStaker.sol#302)
	StableStaker.userInfo (src/StableStaker.sol#78) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- StableStaker.pendingReward(address,address) (src/StableStaker.sol#644-654)
	- StableStaker.userInfo (src/StableStaker.sol#78)
	- user.rewardDebt = (user.amount * pool.accPhusdPerShare) / ACC_PRECISION (src/StableStaker.sol#304)
	StableStaker.userInfo (src/StableStaker.sol#78) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- StableStaker.pendingReward(address,address) (src/StableStaker.sol#644-654)
	- StableStaker.userInfo (src/StableStaker.sol#78)

StableStaker._routeExit(address,uint256,bool) (src/StableStaker.sol#773-793) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- t.balanceOf(address(this)) >= amount (src/StableStaker.sol#783)

StableStaker.setYieldStrategy(address,IYieldStrategy) (src/StableStaker.sol#219-271) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- require(bool,string)(poolInfo[token].totalStaked == 0,StableStaker: pool not empty) (src/StableStaker.sol#228)

StableStaker.finalizeAndReset(address) (src/StableStaker.sol#593-604) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- require(bool,string)(poolInfo[token].totalStaked == 0,StableStaker: principal remains) (src/StableStaker.sol#596)

StableStaker.pendingReward(address,address) (src/StableStaker.sol#644-654) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- poolState[token] == PoolState.Active && block.timestamp > pool.lastRewardTime && pool.totalStaked > 0 (src/StableStaker.sol#647)

StableStaker._updatePool(address) (src/StableStaker.sol#705-726) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp <= pool.lastRewardTime (src/StableStaker.sol#713)
	- reward > 0 (src/StableStaker.sol#722)
Costly operations (storage writes) inside batchMigrate loop; relevant to migration gas exhaustion / partial-batch behaviour.
Return value of _routeExit(token, staked, false) at setYieldStrategy line 249 is ignored (aderyn unchecked-return; slither did not flag this internal-call instance).
Contract uses single-step Ownable; a mistaken transferOwnership permanently hands over/bricks owner functions. Ownable2Step recommended (QA-level owner footgun).
